FORM is a strong underfollowed candidate for HBM and advanced-packaging probe-card/testing exposure; next layer should verify memory probe-card mix and HBM customer pull-through.

summary: Layer 1B expansion found one direct OSAT reference anchor and three underfollowed US-listed equipment/test suppliers tied to advanced packaging, HBM-adjacent probe/test, thermocompression bonding, and inspection/metrology. The strongest direct exposure is Amkor as a packaging-and-test platform; the cleaner underfollowed chokepoint candidates are FormFactor for HBM/advanced-packaging probe cards, Kulicke & Soffa for advanced-packaging assembly equipment, and Cohu for HBM inspection/metrology and semiconductor test automation.
